label: Bible Study
prompt: If we live in the Spirit, let us also _____ in the Spirit.
verse: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
note: Life in the Spirit, one step at a time — Paul's follow-up to the fruit of the Spirit.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: _____, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
verse: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
note: Zephaniah calls Zion to sing, shout, and be glad with all the heart — the gloom has lifted.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a _____:
verse: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
note: The wise man's house stood because of what was under it — the rock is hearing Jesus' sayings and actually doing them.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief _____ stone;
verse: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
note: Apostles and prophets form the foundation; Christ is the cornerstone everything else lines up with.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and _____ in pain together until now.
verse: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
note: All creation 'groaneth and travaileth' — in labor pains — waiting for the coming redemption.
